name: Italian Game
description: A classical opening focused on quick development and control of the center.

variations.name: Giuoco Piano
variations.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Bc5 4. c3 Nf6 5. d4 exd4 6. cxd4 Bb4+

explanations.e4: Control the center and open lines for your pieces.
explanations.Nf3: Develop your knight and attack e5.
explanations.Nc6: Black develops and protects the e5 pawn.
explanations.Bc4: Develop your bishop toward the vulnerable f7 square.
explanations.Bc5: Black develops the bishop and mirrors your setup.
explanations.c3: Prepare to build a strong pawn center with d4.
explanations.Nf6: Black develops and attacks your e4 pawn.
explanations.d4: Establish a strong central pawn presence.
explanations.Bb4+: Black gives check with the bishop.
